repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires the condition ($v1 - $v2) >= 20, meaning the volume must drop by at least 20 units. The candidate script uses (v2 - v1 >= 20), which triggers when the volume rises by 20 units. This sign inversion causes the action to fire on an increase instead of a decrease, as seen in F2 where the action fired despite the input history showing a constant high volume (no drop occurred).
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the `if` condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic for detecting a volume drop.
